{"metadata":{"description":"Role-based AI swarm orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: per-role model pinning with fallbacks, parallel task DAG with review loops, live Swarm dashboard tab.","id":"gh:1354857499","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-swarm-orchestrator","slug":"linkbag/dsh-swarm-orchestrator","topics":["cordis","dashboard","dsh","dsh-plugin","multi-agent","orchestration","swarm"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Role-based AI swarm orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: per-role model pinning with fallbacks, paral"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"lel task DAG with review loops, live Swarm dashboard tab."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-swarm-orchestrator"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Role-based AI swarms for DeepSeek Harness. Give it a goal, get a team: an architect breaks the work "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"into a task graph, parallel builders execute it, reviewers hold the line, and an integrator ships th"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"e result — while you watch the whole thing move on a live kanban board."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It runs **inside** your `dsh web` host. No daemon, no second process, no glue scripts. Task agents a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"re ordinary DSH subagents with your tool access and your models; the orchestrator is just a well-beh"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"agents with your tool access and your models; the orchestrator is just a well-behaved Cordis plugin."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It has already shipped real work: the first production run reverse-engineered a biotech research das"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"hboard and rebuilt it as a **six-indication suite** (680 curated clinical trials across six cancers)"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" in a single afternoon — five data-curation agents working in parallel, every deliverable machine-ve"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ingle afternoon — five data-curation agents working in parallel, every deliverable machine-verified."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## At a glance"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**dsh-swarm-orchestrator** turns one goal into a supervised agent team inside DeepSeek Harness: an a"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"rchitect reviews your plan into `PLAN.md`, parallel builders execute it as a task DAG, reviewers gat"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"e quality, an integrator ships. Every role runs a model you pin from your live catalog, every delive"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"rable can be machine-verified, and the whole pipeline is visible on a live kanban + flow chart."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Example Kanban View (real-time workflow)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Optional hybrid workteam"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Why not just ask one agent?"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Because one agent serializes. Long research tasks queue behind quick edits, context fills up, qualit"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"y drifts, and nothing checks the output but the same model that wrote it."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"This plugin takes the coordination seriously so you don't have to:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Parallel by construction.** Tasks declare dependencies (`blockedBy`); everything independent run"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"s at once, bounded by a concurrency cap that adapts when the provider struggles.
- **Every role gets"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" its own model.** Pin DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Claude — any model configured in DSH — to any role, with "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"an ordered fallback chain and a per-role reasoning-effort ladder. The picker reads your live model c"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"atalog, so new providers show up automatically.
- **Review before "done" means done.** Tasks tagged "},{"id":"p15s6","text":"`reviewBy` are judged by a reviewer agent against the task brief; a rejection loops back to the buil"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"der with the feedback attached. Want the last word yourself? Set `reviewGate: "human"` and approve f"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"rom the dashboard.
- **Failure is a state, not a mystery.** Provider timeouts, quota exhaustion, bad"},{"id":"p15s9","text":" evidence — each is detected, reported plainly, and handled: retries with resume hints, run pause/re"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"sume instead of burn-down, automatic model rotation after repeated failures.
- **Scoped to where you"},{"id":"p15s11","text":" are.** Each chat's Swarm tab shows the runs for that chat's workspace; a persisted switch reveals e"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"verything on the machine when you want the full picture.
- **One run per goal, reviewed before built"},{"id":"p15s13","text":".** Dispatching into a workspace with an active run raises a warning (or a block, your choice); and "},{"id":"p15s14","text":"unless you opt out, an architect agent reviews the dispatcher's plan into PLAN.md before any builder"},{"id":"p15s15","text":" starts.
- **Shared concurrency budget.** Swarm agents run in-process on the DSH host, sharing its N"},{"id":"p15s16","text":"ode.js heap. A global cap (`maxTotalConcurrentAgents`, default 100) shares the budget across runs an"},{"id":"p15s17","text":"d counts cancelling holders until cleanup. Choose a much lower cap on memory-constrained hosts; no f"},{"id":"p15s18","text":"ixed cap guarantees memory safety.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Reviewed hardening plan (0.6.33)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"This release implements the reviewed S0–S7 hardening plan. A rebuilt bundle or build receipt is not "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"proof that an already-running host loaded it: deployment needs an intentional reload/restart and an "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"exclusive-storage upgrade check."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Physical ownership survives cancellation.** Same-task replacement, dependent readers, reviews an"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"d recovery wait for retained child/Shell holders to drain, even with spare capacity. Persisted revie"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ws resume the same attempt once; builder success and acceptance-pending are committed together. A ru"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"n cannot announce completion while its writers drain.
- **Execution is not acceptance.** New runs pe"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"rsist policy version 1 and separate execution, artifact, acceptance and provenance states. Legacy po"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"licy-absent histories keep their historical advisory/fail-open meaning. Task overrides can strengthe"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"n, never weaken, the run policy.
- **Evidence:** `advisory` (default) records file/structural warnin"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"gs; `required` holds missing/invalid artifacts. Commands always require zero exit. Artifact contract"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"s validate bounded regular files, JSON/JSONL/text/binary shape, own required keys, optional schema v"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"ersion, record count and SHA-256. Readable invalid bytes still have content identity. This is struct"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"ural validation, not scientific/clinical approval or immutable publication.
- **Review:** `warn` (de"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"fault) labels unavailable/exhausted reviews without claiming approval; `strict` holds unavailable/ma"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"lformed/exhausted review for a human; `off` explicitly skips review. Strict review without an assign"},{"id":"p18s14","text":"ed reviewer defaults to a human gate. Required/strict acceptance cannot be bypassed by external comp"},{"id":"p18s15","text":"letion.
- **Observed decisions:** review uses the displayed `attemptId`, `reviewEpisode` and `artifa"},{"id":"p18s16","text":"ctDigest`; complete/interrupt/retry use the displayed `attemptId`, `status` and revocation flag. New"},{"id":"p18s17","text":"-policy callers must send these observations. Stale decisions return HTTP 409 without mutation; dura"},{"id":"p18s18","text":"ble decisions include an ID, authenticated actor label, reason and observed identity. Fetching a new"},{"id":"p18s19","text":"er identity just before sending defeats stale-intent protection and is not supported UI behavior.

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"#### Storage upgrade and operational recovery"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"A writable `EventStore` acquires a non-expiring exclusive-create `.owner` marker **before loading or"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" torn-tail repair** and holds it through append/fsync/rollback and service drain. A second cooperati"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ng writer refuses to open; it never silently becomes a reader. `new EventStore(file, { readOnly: tru"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"e })` is an explicit write-free replay snapshot, not a concurrent transaction or automatic tail repa"},{"id":"p20s5","text":")` is an explicit write-free replay snapshot, not a concurrent transaction or automatic tail repair."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
